decisions.decision: view_count as primary quality signal (log scale, capped 9pts)

decisions.decision: Penalty -3pts for: letra, lyrics, lyric video, karaoke, bass boosted, sped up, slowed, nightcore, 8d audio, reverb, pitched
decisions.rationale: Prevents non-original versions winning despite higher artist-in-title score
